about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (4,2), MegaMan with a folder of Z Saver Z in both games, BN5's chip 218 by BN5's own code and the registry's 294 by the same code moved (BN5's family 0x34 as BN6's 0x84), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md). To t88: its third slash deletes the foe, whose deletion's flash at t89 stands at the moved family's own point (BN6's arm-point records for its NameID: the virus families' track's, as chip_blinder's mark).
subject: megaman
